label: Midnight Ink
description: A deep dark theme with cool blue primary and warm amber accent. Built for portfolios, personal brands and creative professionals.
notes: Tokens only — sections never hardcode colours, they read these as CSS variables. Dark comes from the token palette, not from mode — tokens supply a near-black bg and surface, light text, and a muted grey that still clears WCAG AA on dark. Changing `primary` here restyles every section, every page, instantly.
